title: anibench multimodal judge answer for one clip
description: Same questions and codes as the human raters (tools/rater.html, src/study/common.py). One object per clip. A judge run is collected as JSONL (one object per line) or as a rating export {schema: 'anibench-rating-v1', rater_id: 'judge:<name>', rater_kind: 'judge', ratings: [...]}; src/study/analyze.py reads both.

pass.description: Did the animation do what was asked without breaking anything else?

defects.description: Empty if pass is true; at least one code if pass is false.

other_text.description: Required (non-empty) when defects contains 'other'; else empty.

reason.description: One or two sentences naming what you saw.
